title: Activities
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:16 AM
Activities

The Customizing delivered contains all required submission statuses. If you also want to implement a company-specific status for
submitted items, you have to enter this in Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable, under: |}Business
Transactions » Submit to Collection Agency } Define Submission Status

If, in the manual or automatic submission of a receivable, in addition to the items of a business partner already released for

submission, you also want to submit all items or due items for this business partner to a collection agency without first releasing
them, writing them off, or dunning them:

Program an installation-specific function module using the sample function module FKK_SAMPLE_5069. See the documentation
for the function module.

Define this function module for event 5069 in Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable, under: |}Program
Enhancements » Define Customer-Specific Function Modules

In the Submit Receivables to Collection Agencies transaction (SAP Easy Access screen: |}»Account » Submit for Collection
Submit Items for Collection 3; transaction FP@3D) or in the Submit to Collection Agencies mass run (SAP Easy Access screen:

Periodic Processing For Contract Accounts Submit for Collection J; transaction FPQ3DM), select the Submit Additional
Items indicator.

If you want the system to set payment locks, dunning locks, or alternative payers in the document, set the indicator for the
required action in Customizing for Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable, under: |'Business Transactions » Submit to
Collection Agency » Define Specs for Submission to External Collection Agency

In event 5058, you have the option of running additional checks before submitting items to a collection agency. You can also
exclude items from being submitted. If you use debt recovery scores, you can implement different check variants for the debt

recovery score.

At event 5057 you can perform follow-on activities after submission. You can use the sample function module FKK_SAMPLE_5057
for this.

At event 6251, you can initiate follow-on activities for items that were not submitted due to checks before submission (event
5058). You can use the sample function module FKK_SAMPLE_6251] for this.

When you submit using files and you want to add data to the submission file, you can do this in the events below in the areas of the
submission file stated after the event name:

e Event 5062: Header
e Event 5064: Footer

e Event 5063: Items

To add data to the submission file, write function modules and define them for the specified events in Customizing for Contract
Accounts Receivable and Payable, under: |}}Program Enhancements » Define Customer-Specific Function Modules 33. SAP

provides the sample function modules FKK_SAMPLE_5062, FKK_SAMPLE_5063, and FKK_SAMPLE_5064. See also the
documentation for the sample function modules.

For submission via Enterprise Service/API, enhancement options are available. You can add information to outgoing messages in
the following events.
